cues.text: In the home economics room, you and Bebe sew at machines facing each other, a big heap of fabric scraps piled between you.
Bebe stands beside a dress form wearing the finished kimono, a patchwork of many fabrics.
Bebe turns his back to you and stands silent.
He walks over to where you sit, reaches into his pocket and holds out a small cloth pouch, and you take it.
Bebe clutches his fan to his chest and wipes at his eyes.
